nodes.text: Introducing the Aria Studio 爾逸商務艙 全新區域商務艙

Introducing the Aria Studio — where comfort is reimagined in our all-new regional Business class. A state-of-the-art design with a full lie-flat bed and direct aisle access is coming to our Airbus A330-300 flying regional routes. Arriving at the end of 2026.
